         las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4773">tshad ma'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> bsdus pa rigs pa'i sgo 'byed pa</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5911">mdar btsun pa <expan>rin chen</expan> bzang po</rs>s yang dang yang du bskul ba'i ngor dang ¦ gzhan yang shes ldan 'ga' res bskul <expan>ba'i phyir </expan> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5910">shakya'i <lb n="9a6"/> btsun pa <choice><orig>°°°°°°</orig><reg>sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan</reg></choice></rs> <choice><reg>gis</reg><orig>°°</orig></choice> go bde <expan>ba'i phyir</expan> du lung dang <expan>rigs</expan> <expan>pa'i</expan> sgo nas dgag gzhag dang skyon gyi gcod tshul phra mo rnaMs re shig bzhag nas ding sang gi <expan>rtog ge</expan> pa <expan>thams cad</expan> kyi brda cha‹d› dang mthun par <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5697">dben gnas brag dkar</rs> du sbyar ba rdzogs s+ho ||</seg></TEI>
